name: Jump Lists
purpose: Tracks recently/frequently accessed files per application via embedded shell-link data, providing file-access evidence even for files later deleted.
normal_baseline: Entries correspond to files the user is known to have opened with the associated application.
anomalies: Entries referencing files on removable/network shares with no current device
Target file path pointing to a staging or exfiltration directory
anti_forensic_notes: The referenced file does not need to still exist for the Jump List entry to remain, aiding recovery after deletion; can be individually pruned via 'Remove from this list'.
